texts:
Ja'Marr Chase is in the concussion protocol, and Joe Burrow just threw 54 times. That is the best buy of the week.

Trade for him; offer a WR2 and an RB2. Let's get to it.
#WhoDey

Ja'Marr Chase, CIN WR: 3 for 27 before the concussion in the second quarter vs JAX. Zac Taylor calls him day to day.
WR1 rest of season for me. Offer a WR2 and an RB2.

Chase Brown, CIN RB: 10 catches, and 8 carries for 9.
RB6 for me. Offer an RB2 and a bench WR.
#WhoDey

Trey McBride, ARI TE: 10 or more targets in all four games, 46 total, and only 2 TDs. The 31-yard day @NYG is the discount.

TE1 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#BirdGang

Kyren Williams, LAR RB: 70 snaps to Corum's 13 @PHI, 10 of 13 targets, 2 TDs. 21 catches on 25 targets in four games.

RB16 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR3 and a bench RB.
#RamsHouse

Puka Nacua, LAR WR: 9 for 125 @PHI in his first game since Week 1.

WR6 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Monday night vs BUF; offer a WR2 and an RB3.
#RamsHouse

Tetairoa McMillan, CAR WR: 14 of 16 for 192 and 2 TDs vs DET, a week after a route on 92 percent of the dropbacks.

Carolina is on bye, so his manager sits a week with no points. WR20 for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#KeepPounding

Justin Jefferson, MIN WR: missed Week 4 with the ankle. Kevin O'Connell's goal is Jefferson back vs NO.

WR5 rest of season for me. Trade for him before Wednesday's practice report; offer a WR2 and a bench RB.
#Skol

Saquon Barkley, PHI RB: week to week with the hamstring, almost certainly out vs JAX in London. Not considered long term, and Bigsby is on IR.

RB8 rest of season for me. Trade for him while he sits; offer an RB2 who plays this week and a bench WR.
#FlyEaglesFly

Lamar Jackson, BAL QB: 15 of 20 for 222 and 2 TDs in the first half vs TEN, then the left ankle. An outside chance to play @ATL.

QB2 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a QB in the 8 to 12 range and a bench WR.
#RavensFlock

Rashee Rice, KC WR: the hamstring was called relatively minor Monday, and Kansas City is on bye. Tyquan Thornton is out indefinitely.

WR17 rest of season for me. Trade for him over the bye; offer a WR3.
#ChiefsKingdom

Michael Wilson, ARI WR: 17 targets, then 13, 44 in four games. I sold him last week on the catch rate; the volume won.

WR44 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench WR3.
#BirdGang

Carnell Tate, TEN WR: 12 targets @BAL, about 39 percent of Tennessee's, for 9 catches and 145.

WR34 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench RB or a WR4.
#TitanUp

Denzel Boston, CLE WR: 61 snaps (95 percent) vs PIT, 4 of 7 for 89. Cleveland's leading receiver in three of four games.

WR46 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench RB.
#DawgPound

Now the sells.

Javonte Williams, DAL RB: 3 TDs @HOU on 19 carries for 62. 3.7 a carry on the season.

RB11 rest of season for me, and three scores put his price above that. Sell; ask for a WR2.
#DallasCowboys

Woody Marks, HOU RB: a TD two weeks running on 6 carries. David Montgomery out-snapped him 32 to 20.

RB45 rest of season for me. Sell while the touchdowns show; ask for a bench WR with a full-time role.
#HTownMade

T.J. Hockenson, MIN TE: 13 of 13 for 119 with Jefferson out. 2 of 4 for 11 the week before.

TE26 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for a WR3 with a full-time role.
#Skol

Omarion Hampton, LAC RB: 9 touches to Keaton Mitchell's 15 @SEA. He scored, and his snap share went 58, 63 and 42 percent before that.

RB12 for me. Sell; ask for a top-15 RB who catches passes, or a WR2.
#BoltUp

Jaylen Warren, PIT RB: 69 of 71 snaps and 20 touches @CLE with Rico Dowdle out with the toe. Dowdle's return splits it again.

RB26 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for an RB2 with a three-down role.
#HereWeGo

Drake Maye, NE QB: 3 TDs @BUF and 54 rushing yards, after 1 TD and 6 INTs in three games. A.J. Brown is on IR and Mack Hollins hurt the calf.

QB10 for me. Sell; ask for a QB2 with a steadier floor and a WR3.
#NEPats

Jacory Croskey-Merritt, WAS RB: 45 percent of the snaps in London, down from 57, and 9 carries for 15. Austin Ekeler took 17 snaps in his first game.

RB35 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for a bench WR with a role.
#RaiseHail

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB: 42 percent of the snaps @SF while RJ Harvey caught 10. 3.5 a carry on 46 carries.

RB32 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for a bench RB with a clearer role.
#BroncosCountry

Marvin Harrison Jr., ARI WR: 9 targets in three games, under 80 percent of the snaps each week, while Wilson drew 30 in two.

WR43 rest of season for me. Sell; ask for a bench WR3 with a full-time role.
#BirdGang

George Kittle, SF TE: 4 for 70 vs DEN, 56 of it on one touchdown.

TE10 rest of season for me. Sell after the long score; ask for a TE in the 6 to 9 range.
#FTTB

The one trade to make today: buy Ja'Marr Chase while he sits in the protocol. Burrow threw 54 times without him for most of Week 4.

Offer a WR2 and an RB2.
#WhoDey

Every buy and sell with its price is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu tomorrow, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/butcher.html?week=5
